name: safeturn-monorepo
description: SafeTurn smart helmet rider app, family alert H5, real-time admin dashboard and server monorepo.

scripts.build: npm -w @safeturn/shared run build && npm -w @safeturn/server run build && npm -w @safeturn/admin-dashboard run build && npm -w @safeturn/rider-app run build && npm -w @safeturn/family-h5 run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,admin,rider,family -c cyan,green,blue,magenta,yellow "npm -w @safeturn/shared run build:watch" "npm -w @safeturn/server run dev" "npm -w @safeturn/admin-dashboard run dev" "npm -w @safeturn/rider-app run dev" "npm -w @safeturn/family-h5 run dev"
scripts.dev:server: npm -w @safeturn/shared run build && npm -w @safeturn/server run dev
scripts.dev:admin: npm -w @safeturn/shared run build && npm -w @safeturn/admin-dashboard run dev
scripts.dev:rider: npm -w @safeturn/shared run build && npm -w @safeturn/rider-app run dev
scripts.dev:family: npm -w @safeturn/shared run build && npm -w @safeturn/family-h5 run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @safeturn/shared run typecheck && npm -w @safeturn/server run typecheck && npm -w @safeturn/admin-dashboard run typecheck && npm -w @safeturn/rider-app run typecheck && npm -w @safeturn/family-h5 run typecheck
